message:
The other day, we found ourselves caught in a sudden storm warning. As the clouds rolled in, our family group chat lit up. 😅 My sister was frantically asking if we had our go-bags ready, while my mom was sharing her latest water storage hack. It was a mix of humor and practicality, with everyone chiming in about what they had on hand. 

In that moment, it struck us how just a little preparation can turn a potentially stressful situation into a team effort. It's comforting to know that we’re all in this together, ready to support one another. 

What’s your go-to tip for keeping your family prepared?
